gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The plane made a hard but ___ (SUCCESS) landing.
The manager praised the team for its ___ (COMMIT) to quality.
gaps.explanation: The noun from COMMIT is 'commitment' — a dedication to a course of action.

gaps.sentence: ___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: The signing of the armistice was a ___ (HISTORY) moment for the region.
gaps.explanation: 'Historic' = momentous, making history; 'historical' merely means related to the past.
